messages:
alex.k: FYI customer ACME opened a support escalation: repeated 500s on /v1/generate and they're asking if audit logs show data retained beyond 90 days and whether our KMS/HSM keys were involved. Also asking for timeline + credits. Repro steps below.

alex.k: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","input":"hello"}' --max-time 10

Response: HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
{"error":"internal_server_error","detail":"KVCacheMiss followed by KMS: key not found"}
```

sara.m: thanks. assigning to @oncall-bot to create an incident and get initial triage. can someone check workspace retention config and key metadata? :eyes:

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-457 created for ACME escalation. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/incident-kms-retention. Pager duty: oncall-sre.

matt.r: I'll start by checking KMS metadata and audit log slices for that workspace (acme-prod). wondering if this was a rotated/deleted key or a transient permission issue.

alex.k: logs show repeated 500s between 2026-04-10T14:02:10Z and 14:04:30Z, with entries like: `KMS: decrypt failed: key not found` and `kvcache: miss: prefix id=...`. attaching snippet.

matt.r: quick check: acme-prod is using our managed key rw-key-123 (created 2023-08-12). no HSM-backed key configured on their workspace. no deletion events logged in KMS trace. I'll dig into key usage entries in audit logs.

sara.m: customer specifically wants confirmation IF any plaintext request/response logs were retained longer than 90 days. legal-ops - can you advise on next steps for customer-facing language? also need to know if we should proactively offer credits.

legal-ops: recommend we avoid definitive customer statements until we verify. suggested interim reply: "We're investigating. At this time we have no evidence of data retained beyond your configured retention window; we will provide a timeline and the relevant audit entries within 24 hours." copy SOC and SRE on the note. For credits, wait for root cause.

matt.r: pulled audit slice for the incident window. KMS key rw-key-123 shows decrypt requests from our service principal at 2026-04-10T14:02:09Z and 14:03:21Z. No key management events (rotate/delete) in 30 days. Audit log export (sanitized) will be attached to the thread. No HSM entries.

alex.k: thanks. customer also asked if we will notify other customers if this was a platform-wide issue. looks isolated to their workspace in logs.

sara.m: agree isolated for now. ops/billing-ops - if we offer a goodwill credit what range is typical for a brief outage? thinking 5-10% of last month's bill.

billing-ops: 10% is within standard guidelines for first-party infra incidents under 1 hour with measurable SLA miss. we'll draft a credit memo once support confirms scope.

oncall-bot: Status update: monitoring. Next actions: (1) matt.r to attach sanitized audit export, (2) security to confirm no HSM involvement, (3) legal to approve customer wording, (4) billing to prepare credit pathway if needed. ETA: 2 hours for initial package.

matt.r: attaching export link (sanitized): https://internal.redwood/secure-exports/acme-prod-audit-1768501234.csv.gpg (will add to ticket). also running a broader scan for any workspace-level retention overrides.

alex.k: I'll draft the customer message using legal's template and include the export. draft will say we found no evidence of retention beyond configured 90-day window and no HSM key activity. will ask if they'd like a call.

sara.m: great. keep this thread updated. ping @legal-ops and @billing-ops when draft is ready so they can approve. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-457 remains open. Next update scheduled + monitoring alerts set for 30m.

alex.k: Draft ready and sent to legal-ops for approval. Will paste final message here before sending to customer.

matt.r: follow-up: broadened scan found one legacy project under the customer with retention override (120d) but it had zero traffic and no logs in the incident window. Not relevant to the 500s.

alex.k: thanks all — will send customer the approved message and offer the billing credit contingent on confirmed root cause. closing in 24h unless we find additional evidence.
